findings.title: Recurring cancellation does not wait for calendar deletions
findings.body: This async callback is passed to `forEach`, which does not await it. Because `getCalendar` now yields before the deletion promises are added to `apiDeletes`, execution can reach the later `Promise.all(apiDeletes)` and finish cleanup before these deletions are even scheduled. The handler can delete booking references while leaving recurring events on users' calendars; deletion errors can also become unhandled rejections. Collect and await these callback promises (or use a sequential loop) before continuing.

findings.title: All app imports start eagerly when the store is loaded
findings.body: Each `import()` is evaluated while this object is initialized, so importing the app store immediately starts loading every app package, even when a request needs only one integration. This retains the startup/module-loading cost the async-import change is intended to avoid and can load heavyweight apps unnecessarily. Defer each import until its app is requested, for example by storing import functions rather than their already-started promises.
